# Asset naming

Keep the source visual pack flat in this folder because the current build pipeline references these names directly.

## Locked room assets

- `room-before.png` — master room / source of truth
- `room-botanical.png`
- `room-stripe.png`
- `room-arch.png`
- `room-grid.png`
- `room-chalk.png`
- `room-moss-trail.png`
- `room-foreground.png`

## Wallpaper assets

- `swatch-botanical.png`
- `swatch-stripe.png`
- `swatch-arch.png`
- `swatch-grid.png`
- `swatch-plain.png`
- `swatch-moss-trail.png`
- `wallpaper-flatlay.png`

## Mask

- `wall-mask.png`

## Generated files

`assets/build/` is generated by `tools/build_assets.py` and is intentionally ignored by Git.

## Audio

Place licensed soundtrack files in `assets/audio/` locally. Raw Epidemic Sound audio is intentionally ignored by Git.
